title: CodeChallenge: Measure and correct BERT's bias

cues.en: This will be an interesting code challenge.
cues.zh: 這會是有趣的程式挑戰。

cues.en: You will combine concepts that you learned in the section on evaluations, with editing techniques that you learned over the past half dozen videos.
cues.zh: 你會結合評估章節學到的概念，以及過去五、六支影片學到的編輯技術。

cues.en: In particular, we are going to test whether there is a gender bias in the Bert model.
cues.zh: 特別是，我們要測試 BERT 模型是否有性別偏誤。

cues.en: And well, spoiler alert there is, at least for the example that we are going to work with.
cues.zh: 先劇透一下，確實有，至少在我們要處理的範例中如此。

cues.en: But the point is this we will elicit that bias, quantify it, and then see if we can actually go into the model and surgically remove that bias.
cues.zh: 重點是，要引出、量化這個偏誤，再看看能否真的進入模型，像外科手術般移除它。

cues.en: Now, just to be clear, say you don't have unrealistic expectations.
cues.zh: 先說清楚，免得有不切實際的期待。

cues.en: What we are going to do here will work for these specific example that we are going to use.
cues.zh: 這裡的做法，會對我們要用的這些特定範例有效。

cues.en: But that does not mean that it's such an easy fix to get rid of biases in general in language models,
cues.zh: 但不代表，要普遍消除語言模型的偏誤，也是這麼容易。

cues.en: The biases that are present in language models were developed by learning from trillions of tokens that
cues.zh: 語言模型中的偏誤，是學習人類撰寫的數兆個 token

cues.en: humans wrote, and so removing one very specific bias in one example is actually surprisingly easy, as you will learn in this code challenge.
cues.zh: 所形成的。所以，在一個範例中移除非常特定的偏誤，其實出乎意料地容易，這次程式挑戰就會學到。

cues.en: But removing biases across any possible example is a lot trickier.
cues.zh: 但要移除所有可能範例中的偏誤，就困難得多。

cues.en: Still possible, but not as simple as what we are going to do here.
cues.zh: 仍然可能，但不像這裡要做的那麼簡單。

cues.en: Anyway, let me begin by reminding you of this slide, which I showed in the section on evaluations in the lecture about bias and fairness.
cues.zh: 總之，先提醒你這張投影片，它曾出現在評估章節，偏誤與公平性的課程中。

cues.en: In particular, I want to focus your attention on this sentence here.
cues.zh: 特別想請你注意這個句子。

cues.en: So what we are going to do here in this video is present this sentence to the model with no pronouns here, just a mask.
cues.zh: 這支影片，我們會把這個句子提供給模型，但這裡沒有代名詞，只有遮罩。

cues.en: And then measure the logit activations to the words she, he, and they.
cues.zh: 再測量 she、he、they 這幾個詞的 logit 活化。

cues.en: That will lead to our quantification of the bias.
cues.zh: 藉此量化偏誤。

cues.en: And I'll get into the details of how we are going to undo that bias in a later exercise.
cues.zh: 後面的練習，會詳細說明如何消除這個偏誤。

cues.en: Although I can, I think you can probably already guess what we're going to do based on the description of exercise one.
